name: LocateTicketManager
tagline: Answer every 811 ticket on time – due dates, dispatch, marking and positive response in one Power Platform app.
description: Complete one-call locate desk for utilities: legal response due times with business days, holidays and emergency windows, status board from received to responded with extensions, joint meets and remarks, positive response with codes, APWA marking colours and photo evidence, dispatch lanes per locator with capacity, an offline area map and locator workload – for canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: Response due calculated from business days, holidays and emergency hours
Status rules with drag and drop
Positive response codes with APWA marking colours and photo rule
Extensions with limits, joint meets, remarks
Locator capacity and dispatch day plan
CSV, positive response, dispatch and summary JSON outputs
controlType: standard (2 controls: LocateTicketManager data-set + LocateTicketManagerPortal field control)
